reviews.review_description: Absolutely satisfied with our 12kw installation - we wanted the best panels available at the time with individual micro inverters and to also maximise the number of panels in the space we had. Luke & Green Volt nailed it. We had 4 different quotes - GV answered any & every question we had, backed by figures etc & no question was too simple. One of the key things for us was for the person quoting the job understood clearly all installation aspects  - avoiding a salesperson price only to run into problems come installation time. GV worked with us to give us what we wanted yet advised us on what would be best & in the end gave us a highly competent & safe installation, with excellent after-sales service… above all else - it smashed our power bill! Highly recommend.

Great Company to deal with. Luke was able to come do an assessment and have a chat within a few days of our first conversation. Luke is a down to earth, no-nonsense guy, evidently passionate about what he does and doesn't try to push a sale. We got quotes from 6 other companies but after having a chat with Luke, I just felt comfortable and confident that they would deliver a quality system with a quality installation. The whole process was painless, Luke was happy to answer any questions promptly and communication was great. On the day of the installation the 3 man team arrived on time, were very polite, and just got stuck in. The installers were a bunch or really nice guys, really decent and very hard working yet still keen for a chat.The team conducted the work in a very safe manner, by installing safety rails around the work area before starting the job. They did a thorough assessment of our roof before starting the installation and found a couple of potential leaks, which led me to arranging a roof assessment for a few days later. Before starting the installation, the guys went out of their way to assist and subsequently replaced approx. 30 roof tiles for us and also made sure that all tiles around the location of the solar panels were all in good condition.  The installation was extremely neat and tidy and the guys left our place spotless. We are very happy with the service we have received from Green Volt and highly recommend them. Great to deal with decent guys that are down to earth and take pride in their work.

I contacted Luke-GreenVolt Solar in May 2022, along with nuymerous other installers.  He came and we discussed what I wanted,not what he could sell me. Luke was knowledgeable, patient and pragmatic.After wandering down a rabbit hole (thanks SolarQuotes haha), and exploring many options (REC Alpha pure/.Enphase, etc.etc.) Luke, patiently offered quite a number of quotes. The system that was installed satisfied all of my goals. I was confident GreenVolt was the right choice from the outset.I also had the consumer mains upgraded and a new power box installed.The installation was fantastic, Darren, young Luke and Aaron were some of the best tradies I have encountered. My place was left spotless, the team was punctual. Luke organised everything, including a very good Level 2 elec, who was professional/punctual and tidy, putting it all together, including the smart meter. Luke put the panels online, installing a Fronius consumption meter and took me through the Solarweb process.Green Volt has ticked all the boxes for me, not least of which was an immaculate installation.

We highly recommend Green Volt. Luke, owner and CEO, recommended a simpler string system which enabled us to purchase a larger system for a competitive price. Micro-inverters, recommended by others, were unnecessary in our situation because we don't have shading problems.We particularly appreciated:- that the person who quoted and designed the system also installed it- clear communication and prompt responses to contacts and questions- the quality of the workmanship- on time every time and cleaned up afterwardWe are incredibly pleased with the amount of power generated, even on overcast days.We have no hesitation in recommending Luke and Green Volt to design, supply and install your solar PV system.

Luke came to our house and answered all our questions and laid out our options in an informative mannerHe assisted us in obtaining a reliable plumber to replace our aging hot water system and coordinated the staged installation process with themThe solar system installers managed to get the inverter and roof panels installed and connected up in a day despite some fairly poor weather conditions

Luke took the time to answer all my questions and quoted me on multiple systems. Other installers only gave me one "solution".Luke was the only installer to consider our usage pattern and designed the layout to provide most solar generation in the afternoon when our consumption is highest - giving us the greatest financial benefit.Luke was the only installer to use real-life numbers (solar generation and self-consumption profile) to calculate the savings from our system. Other installers used questionable assumptions that calculated a higher savings that may not be achieved in real life.The Green Volt Solar Installation Team did a great job taking care to complete a professional installation and leaving no mess.We are very happy we made the right decision to go with Green Volt Solar.

The moment I spoke to Luke I knew I had the right company. His knowledge and excellent customer service shone throughout the whole process. He took the time to talk to me about options and educated me along the way (property with a lots of shade in winter) All this before he even came out to quote me! From the quote to installation was 3 weeks. Installation was smooth and very professional. He even gave my neighbour a quote! I couldn’t be happier with Green Volt Solar. Thanks Luke!
Luke from green volt arrived on time and delivered everything he promised. The installation team were on time ,polite and easy to work with. Luke is arranging the grid connection.

Luke was knowledgeable, friendly and provided exceptional advice. Punctual, helpful, practical.Very pleased with the installation.Would recommend Green Volt to others.
